The '''Kashyyyk Space Station''', or simply '''Kashyyyk Station''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] under the supervision of the [[Civilian Protection Guild]]. This organization was dedicated to the defense of civilian merchants, galactic tradesmen and all legitimate space-borne businesses in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Kashyyyk Space Station appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
